name: Drop Odds
author: yamyi
description:
In the Library, names the duelists who drop the card under the cursor and how often. The weights come off the disc, and the game picks one card per duel won straight out of them, so each row is the real chance per duel:
chance = weight out of 2048, for the rank that pool belongs to
Each duelist appears once, with its best rank of the three. Cards the Library does not show yet are left alone. For the same table with a rarity score beside it, use Card Name Color instead, which carries this panel and tints card names by the same figures.

settings.label: Duelists listed
settings.description: How many duelists the table lists, 1 to 20. The rest are counted under it.

settings.label: Order by
settings.description: Which column orders the table. Its heading is lit. Weight lists the highest first; Duelist and Rank arrange the same duelists by name or by rank. Chance is a fixed fraction of the weight, so it needs no ordering of its own.

settings.label: Position across
settings.description: The panel's left edge, from the left of the picture, in menu units so it holds its place as the window changes size.

settings.label: Position down
settings.description: The panel's top edge, from just under the menu bar, in menu units.
